# ContentCard

```ts
import { ContentCard } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

The horizontal content card template (Figma _elements / content card, node 183:11846). It's content that slots into a Card: a text column (eyebrow, title, body, actions) beside a square media slot.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `leadingText` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Eyebrow text above the title (Figma "Leading text", secondary color). |
| `leadingIcon` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional 24px icon before the leading text; inherits the text color. |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | The card title (Figma 18px bold.18). |
| `body` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Body paragraph (Figma 14px regular.14.body, secondary color). |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Actions row — a cake& Button group (secondary before primary). |
| `media` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Square media on the trailing side — an image or any node; clipped to a 16px radius. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'title'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
import { Card, ContentCard } from '@/cakeand/components/Card';
import { Button } from '@/cakeand/components/Button';

<Card>
  <ContentCard
    leadingIcon={<BadgeCheck />}
    leadingText="Leading text"
    title="Content card title"
    body="Lorem ipsum…"
    actions={
      <>
        <Button size="sm" variant="tonal" intent="secondary">Label</Button>
        <Button size="sm">Primary</Button>
      </>
    }
    media={<img src="cover.jpg" alt="" />}
  />
</Card>
```

## Design tokens used

`--space-500`, `--space-600`, `--space-300`, `--space-200`, `--type-size-subject`, `--color-text-icon-secondary`, `--type-size-subtitle`, `--font-weight-bold`, `--color-text-icon-primary`, `--type-size-body`, `--radius-300`

## Accessibility

- The title renders as an <h3>; keep heading order coherent with the page.
- leadingIcon is decorative (aria-hidden); the leading text carries meaning.
- Give real media an alt (or alt="" if purely decorative); the slot doesn't add one for you.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Place the secondary Button before the primary | Lead with the primary — it breaks the action hierarchy |
| Use the media slot for a square image or illustration | Stretch a wide banner into the 200px square |
| Slot it into a <Card> | Render it bare — it has no surface or elevation of its own |

---
